hypothesis: A positive implementation-closure lane may be made tractable by moving execution into a tiny hermetic deterministic capsule where all consequence-relevant variation is explicit finite boundary input, ambient capabilities are structurally absent, exact program bytes and the full boundary are identity-bound, every operational point is exhaustively replayable, and any trap, malformed state, gas exhaustion, or zero-effect execution destroys closure authority.
status_boundary: C1 falsifies this architecture only. It does not yet create a K1 proof kind or production preservation authority.

capsule_surface.consequence_encoding: open-universe SHA-256 commitment of exact EMIT_HEX payload bytes
capsule_surface.closure_rule: all world x boundary points must parse and execute to HALT within gas and emit at least one consequence; relation is the union of every emitted consequence pair

precommitted_attack_vectors: C1-10 gas exhaustion yields INCOMPLETE not closure
C1-11 zero-effect HALT yields INCOMPLETE not vacuous closure
C1-12 undeclared input slot yields INCOMPLETE
C1-13 empty boundary domain is malformed
C1-14 duplicate world domain is malformed
C1-15 exact program byte mutation changes target identity
C1-16 boundary shrink changes target identity
C1-17 gas mutation changes target identity
C1-18 first-effect-only projection is detectably non-exhaustive
positive_controls: C1-P1 exact exhaustive finite capsule closes
C1-P2 world/value enumeration order is representation-invariant
C1-P3 arbitrary target-native consequence payload survives open universe
forbidden_repairs: do not add ambient capability exceptions to make a vector pass
do not treat gas exhaustion or missing consequence as safe
do not close the consequence universe to known payload labels
do not weaken exact program/boundary/gas identity binding
do not claim arbitrary native-code adequacy from capsule results
decision_after_gate: If C1 survives, the next candidate is a separately versioned bounded-capsule closure proof object plus two independent checkers. If it fails, repair the capsule constitution before any proof lane is implemented.
